lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using när-clauses to talk about timing in routines.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A short office conversation about mornings, lunch, and the commute.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare morning routines and talk about what they do when they arrive at work.

main_focus.name: när-clauses for routine timing
main_focus.description: Use när to show when something happens in a familiar routine.
model_examples: När jag kommer till jobbet, tar jag kaffe.
Jag lyssnar på en podd när jag åker buss.
När mötet är klart, äter vi lunch.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use när-clauses naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic V2 word order in main clauses
basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska, måste

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use routine time chunks and transport words where they fit.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about the morning or commute.
dialogue_shape.middle: They describe two or three routine moments using när.
dialogue_shape.ending: They end by agreeing on the next activity, such as lunch or coffee.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat när in predictable routine contexts

focus: the order of the morning routine
the transport or timing detail that matters
what happens after a routine moment

sentence_focus: one sentence with När jag kommer fram
one sentence about commuting by bus or bike
one sentence about coffee or lunch timing
one sentence with after or before a meeting
one sentence combining routine and timing with när
